notes: Adamsdown_Boy - information as at v8.0.0.6 PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for killing boss-tier Subjugators. As per @mossy_max (https://x.com/mossy_max/status/1804893174965338387) - boss-tier Subjugators have a 20% damage reduction to all non-matching damage, going up to 30% DR to all damage after they "screech", which counts as a shield in-game and reacts to shield-based trait perks. Bite of the Fox - which can still be obtained at the time of writing from legacy Iron Banner engram focussing. First, Arrowhead Brake to help with recoil, or Chambered Compensator or Polygonal Rifling will also to help land consistent crits). Then Appended Mag which, with a Backup Mag mod, gets you to 5 in the mag (again, if your drop one, Extended Mag works too). Envious Assassin in the first trait perk column overflows the mag up to 15, or Rapid Hit helps lands crits and boosts reload speed, as a second choice. Finally, Under-Over provides +50% damage against the boss Subjugator "shield". The Skuling Wolf origin trait is pointless outside of PvP, unfortunetely. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Aggressive(72) Kinetic Sniper Rifle Special Ammo. "Bite of the Fox finally returns to us in a better capacity. Envious Assassin and Vorpal Weapon will bump up your magazine and give some incredible damage. It’s not a dedicated high-dps weapon for raid bosses, but could be better for GMs or general strikes."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Aggressive(72) Kinetic Sniper Rifle Special Ammo. "One quick roll to get out of the way is Slickdraw with either Opening Shot or Moving Target. With Slickdraw you can invest entirely into range and get 100 range and 100 handling even before Opening Shot. Moving Target will be more passive and grant you +10 Aim Assist. Snapshot and Opening Shot are the bread and butter rolls most Guardians will opt for, but keep an eye out for Slickdraw."
